core_claims.name: add / mul / power / monus
core_claims.scope: Total structurally recursive natural addition, multiplication, exponentiation (including zero exponent), and truncated subtraction on all Nat inputs.

core_claims.name: seven / addExample / mulExample / powerExample / monusExample
core_claims.scope: Closed constructor and arithmetic equalities: seven; 3+4=7; 3*4=12; 3^4=81; 3 monus 5=0 and 5 monus 3=2. Universal laws are explicitly deferred to Induction.

core_claims.name: Bin / inc / toBin / fromBin / normalize
core_claims.scope: Unbounded raw binary bitstrings permitting leading zeros; total carry increment, conversion in both directions, and normalization through Nat. toBin zero is the single zero.

core_claims.name: binaryExamples / binaryValues / carryExample
core_claims.scope: Checked conversion in each direction on zero through four, and the carry from eleven to twelve.

deviations: Uses Idris built-in inductive Nat and numeral elaboration instead of redefining Agda naturals and BUILTIN pragmas. All tutorial arithmetic is defined explicitly.
Agda-specific editor keystrokes and historical narrative are condensed into explanations of constructors, finite values, totality, and a completed-code checking workflow.

verification.compiler: Idris2 0.8.0 via the pinned Nix environment
verification.totality: %default total; no proof holes, postulates, unsafe casts or termination overrides
verification.independent_acceptance: Recorded separately by the primary editor and independent reviewer
